evidence.quote: QIA announced today that it has joined Apptronik’s $520 million Series A-X extension round as a new investor, alongside AT&T Ventures and John Deere. The extension follows Apptronik’s $415 million oversubscribed initial Series A raised in 2025, bringing the total Series A to more than $935 million. … With the new capital, Apptronik will accelerate production of its award-winning humanoid robot, Apollo™, and expand its global network of commercial deployments and pilot programs.
evidence.source_title: QIA Participates in Apptronik Series A Funding Round to Support Scaled Production and Global Deployment of Apollo™ Humanoid Robots

evidence.quote: Apollo is designed to bring AI into the physical world. With advanced mobility, dexterous manipulation, and the ability to learn new skills, Apollo can help take on physically demanding work in environments built for people. … Apollo’s modular design gives teams flexibility in how robots are deployed. With both bipedal and wheeled mobility options, Apollo can adapt to different environments, workflows, and operational needs. … Improve fulfillment and logistics operations with a humanoid robot designed to help pick, pack, move goods, and reduce the physical strain of repetitive work.
